topic: claude_config_dir validation and leftover per-space profiles (security audit lows)
detail: 2026-11-14 audit lows: (1) validation refuses only an exact (case-insensitive) duplicate claude_config_dir; it does not refuse one nested in another space's, one equal to or inside a gh_config_dir, an isolated root or orch's data folder, ~/.claude itself, or two spellings of one folder through a link. (2) Earlier builds of this branch made <data dir>/spaces/<space>/claude profiles (with a /login and transcripts, and a keychain item); nothing removes them, though they stay denied to other spaces. (3) The launcher's --settings JSON is visible to other local users in ps (paths only; documented).
note: 2026-11-14: unchanged by D-61. Related: an allowRead that would hold another space's denied folder (by link or real path) or holds a pattern character is now left out (so a gh_config_dir inside the default gh folder leaves default-login spaces without gh in the sandbox, silently); validation still does not refuse a gh_config_dir or claude_config_dir nested in another's, inside the default gh folder, or holding pattern characters.
